title: oenothera tetragona var. longistipata
intro: Oenothera tetragona var. longistipata, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of the western United States and Canada. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms associated with menopausal hot flashes, as well as supporting skin health. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hormone-regulating properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Evening Primrose include omega-6 fatty acids, particularly gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), which is responsible for its anti-inflammatory and hormone-regulating effects.
